svg.title: Contact sheet: Mission threads
svg.desc: One tile per scenario kind of the family Mission threads, each the chart the engine writes for a bundled example of that kind, labelled with the kind and its ledger status: mission-thread MODELLED. Modelled results from stated inputs, not measurements. Advisory: not type-approved navigation equipment.
